signatureEngine.name: 心弦夜响
signatureEngine.requirement: 装备者的特性与音擎适配特性一致时，音擎效果生效。

refinements.name: 弦音相随
refinements.description: 暴击伤害提升50%；装备者进入接战状态、发动[连携技]、[终结技]时，获得1层[心弦]，每层[心弦]会使装备者的[连携技]和[终结技]无视目标12.5%火属性伤害抗性，最多叠加2层，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
refinements.descriptionEn: CRIT DMG increases by 50%. When the equipper enters combat, or activates a Chain Attack or Ultimate, they gain 1 stack of Heartstring. Each stack of Heartstring allows the equipper's Chain Attack and Ultimate to ignore 12.5% of the target's Fire RES, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

refinements.description: 暴击伤害提升57.5%；装备者进入接战状态、发动[连携技]、[终结技]时，获得1层[心弦]，每层[心弦]会使装备者的[连携技]和[终结技]无视目标14.5%火属性伤害抗性，最多叠加2层，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
refinements.descriptionEn: CRIT DMG increases by 57.5%. When the equipper enters combat, or activates a Chain Attack or Ultimate, they gain 1 stack of Heartstring. Each stack of Heartstring allows the equipper's Chain Attack and Ultimate to ignore 14.5% of the target's Fire RES, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

Each stack of Heartstring allows the equipper's Chain Attack and Ultimate to ignore 20% of the target's Fire RES, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

basic.name: 普通攻击：割弦
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的攻击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
第五段攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to five attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
When the 5th hit lands against an enemy, Evelyn will use her Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.

special.name: 特殊技：锁系控位
special.trigger: 未进入[牵缠禁制]前，点按 【特殊技键】 或 【强化特殊技键】  发动：
special.triggerEn: Before entering Binding Seal, press [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] to activate:
special.description:
未进入[牵缠禁制]前，点按 【特殊技键】 或 【强化特殊技键】  发动：
使用[月辉丝·弦]牵引敌人并突进踢击，造成火属性伤害；
攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Before entering Binding Seal, press [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Use Lunalux Garrote to pull the enemy and charge forward with a kick, dealing Fire DMG.
When the attack hits the enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：束裂式·终型
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form
ex.trigger: 进入[牵缠禁制]后，能量足够时，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: After entering Binding Seal and with enough Energy, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
进入[牵缠禁制]后，能量足够时，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
以被[牵缠禁制]的目标为中心，牵引周围敌人并引爆，造成大量火属性伤害，引爆后将退出[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动时，可以闪避敌人的攻击，若成功触发[极限闪避]，将额外累积25%[燎火]；
牵引周围敌人后，点按 【普通攻击键】 ，可以取消引爆，直接衔接第三段[普通攻击]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
After entering Binding Seal and with enough Energy, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Centered on the target affected by Binding Seal, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG. Binding Seal will end after detonation.
Dodge enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a Perfect Dodge is triggered, gain an additional 25% Burning Embers.
After pulling in surrounding enemies, press [Basic Attack] to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the Basic Attack's 3rd hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：绞缢反制
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
挥动[月辉丝·弦]斩击周围敌人，造成火属性伤害；
攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Use Lunalux Garrote to slash surrounding enemies, dealing Fire DMG;
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：月辉丝·绊
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
使用复数[月辉丝·弦]连续斩击前方范围内敌人并引爆，造成大量火属性伤害；
攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple Lunalux Garrotes and detonates an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG to enemies in the area.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enters Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：月辉丝·弦音
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
使用复数[月辉丝·弦]连续斩击前方范围内敌人并引爆，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动时，伊芙琳将脱掉风衣，并进入[焰舞觉醒]状态，持续整场战斗，[焰舞觉醒]状态下，伊芙琳消耗[燎索点]发动[连携技：月辉丝·绊]时，将会保留1点[燎索点]；
攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，累积1点[燎索点]。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple Lunalux Garrotes and detonates an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG to enemies in the area.
Upon activating this skill, Evelyn removes her jacket and enters the Dance of Awakened Fire state, which lasts for the entire battle. While in the Dance of Awakened Fire state, when Evelyn consumes Burning Tether Points to activate Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare, she will retain 1 point of Burning Tether Point. When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target, entering Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：烈锋
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
挥动[月辉丝·弦]斩击周围敌人，造成火属性伤害；
攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Use Lunalux Garrote to slash surrounding enemies, dealing Fire DMG.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：静默掩护
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：轨迹干涉
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
挥动[月辉丝·弦]进行斩击，随后在前方引发爆炸，造成火属性伤害；
攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Evelyn slashes with Lunalux Garrote, then triggers an explosion ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 进入[牵缠禁制]时，伊芙琳的暴击率提升25%，退出[牵缠禁制]后，伊芙琳仍可继续保有增益，持续10秒；在[牵缠禁制]期间切换至其他角色时，伊芙琳将自动衔接[特殊技：束裂式·I型]。
facts.textEn: Upon entering Binding Seal, Evelyn's CRIT Rate increases by 25%. After leaving Binding Seal, she retains the buff for 10s. If Evelyn switches to another character while in Binding Seal, she will automatically follow up with Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form.

cinema.name: 织梦
cinema.description: 进入战场时，伊芙琳立刻获得1500点喧响值，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；敌人进入[牵缠禁制]后，将被施加[禁锢]效果，伊芙琳攻击带有[禁锢]效果的敌人时，无视目标12%防御力；伊芙琳发动[特殊技：束裂式·I型]或[强化特殊技：束裂式·终型]时，会将[禁锢]效果扩散给所有被招式命中的敌人，被扩散的[禁锢]效果持续10秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering the battlefield, Evelyn immediately gains 1,500 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone Mode. Enemies affected by Binding Seal will be Bound. When Evelyn attacks Bound enemies, she ignores 12% of their DEF. When Evelyn uses Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form or EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form, the Bound effect spreads to all enemies hit by the skill. This spread Bound effect lasts for 10s.

cinema.name: 赴火之舞
cinema.description: 伊芙琳的攻击力提升15%；伊芙琳发动[普通攻击：绞勒式·I型]或[普通攻击：绞勒式·II型]时，将返还所消耗的[燎火]，25秒内最多触发一次；伊芙琳消耗[燎索点]发动[连携技：月辉丝·绊]时，招式的打断等级提升。
cinema.descriptionEn: Evelyn's ATK increases by 15%. When Evelyn uses Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form or Basic Attack: Garrote - Second Form, the Burning Embers consumed will be returned. This effect can trigger once every 25s. When Evelyn consumes Burning Tether Point to trigger Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare, the skill's Interrupt Level increases.

cinema.name: 破茧
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 命运的弦音
cinema.description: 发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，伊芙琳立刻获得等同于自身10%生命值上限的护盾，持有该护盾时，伊芙琳的暴击伤害提升40%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon activating a Chain Attack or Ultimate, Evelyn immediately gains a shield equal to 10% of her Max HP. While this shield exists, Evelyn's CRIT DMG increases by 40%.

cinema.name: 丹缕如霞
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 光与影的牵绊
cinema.description: 发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，伊芙琳将获得[弦影绝锋]，持续20秒；[弦影绝锋]期间，伊芙琳发动[普通攻击]、[冲刺攻击]、[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]命中主要攻击目标时，将额外释放一段[月辉丝·弦]进行追击，对范围内敌人造成等同于伊芙琳375%攻击力的火属性伤害，该伤害会被视为[连携技]伤害，最多触发16次，再次获得[弦影绝锋]时刷新可触发次数。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon launching a Chain Attack or Ultimate, Evelyn gains Shadowstring Edge for 20s. During Shadowstring Edge, when Evelyn hits her primary target with a Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack, she additionally executes a Lunalux Garrote follow-up attack, dealing Fire DMG equal to 375% of her ATK to enemies in the area. This DMG is considered Chain Attack DMG and can trigger up to 16 times. Gaining another Shadowstring Edge will refresh the trigger count.

basic.name: 普通攻击：割弦
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的攻击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
第五段攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to five attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
When the 5th hit lands against an enemy, Evelyn will use her Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.

basic.name: 被动：绑缚
basic.description:
伊芙琳发动招式对敌人造成伤害时，会累积[燎火]；
伊芙琳消耗[燎火]发动[绞勒式]，或消耗[喧响值]发动[终结技]时，会累积1点[燎索点]；
拥有3点[燎索点]后，伊芙琳下一次发动[绞勒式]时，会消耗所有[燎索点]，并将招式替换为打断等级较弱的[连携技：月辉丝·绊]。
basic.descriptionEn:
When Evelyn uses her skills to deal DMG to enemies, she will accumulate Burning Embers.
When Evelyn consumes Burning Embers to activate Garrote or consumes Decibels to perform an Ultimate, she gains 1 Burning Tether Point.
Once Evelyn has 3 Burning Tether Points, her next use of Garrote will consume all Burning Tether Points to instead use a lower Interrupt Level version of Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare.

basic.name: 普通攻击：绞勒式·I型
basic.description:
[燎火]大于等于50%时，长按 【普通攻击键】 或 【特殊技键】 发动：
消耗50%[燎火]，使用[月辉丝·弦]进行斩击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
招式发动后，累积1点[燎索点]。
basic.descriptionEn:
When Burning Embers is at 50% or higher, hold [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack] to activate:
Consume 50% Burning Embers to use Lunalux Garrote to perform a slashing attack, dealing Fire DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

basic.name: 普通攻击：绞勒式·II型
basic.description:
[燎火]大于等于50%时，[普通攻击：绞勒式·I型]发动后，继续长按  【普通攻击键】 或 【特殊技键】 发动：
消耗50%[燎火]，使用[月辉丝·弦]进行追击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
招式发动后，累积1点[燎索点]。
basic.descriptionEn:
When Burning Embers is 50% or higher, after using Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form, continue to hold [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack] to activate:
Consume 50% Burning Embers to use Lunalux Garrote to perform a follow-up attack, dealing Fire DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：穿梭潜袭
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
踢击前方敌人，造成物理伤害；
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a kick to the enemy in front, causing Physical DMG.

ex.name: 特殊技：锁系控位
ex.description:
未进入[牵缠禁制]前，点按 【特殊技键】 或 【强化特殊技键】  发动：
使用[月辉丝·弦]牵引敌人并突进踢击，造成火属性伤害；
攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
Before entering Binding Seal, press [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Use Lunalux Garrote to pull the enemy and charge forward with a kick, dealing Fire DMG.
When the attack hits the enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 特殊技：束裂式·I型
ex.nameEn: Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form
ex.description:
进入[牵缠禁制]后，点按或长按 【特殊技键】 发动：
以被[牵缠禁制]的目标为中心，牵引周围敌人并引爆，造成火属性伤害，引爆后将退出[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动时，可以闪避敌人的攻击，若成功触发[极限闪避]，将额外累积25%[燎火]；
牵引周围敌人后，点按 【普通攻击键】 ，可以取消引爆，直接衔接第三段[普通攻击]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
After entering Binding Seal, press or hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Centered on the target affected by Binding Seal, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing Fire DMG. Binding Seal will end after detonation.
Dodge enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a Perfect Dodge is triggered, gain an additional 25% Burning Embers.
After tethering surrounding enemies, press [Basic Attack] to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the Basic Attack's 3rd hit.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：束裂式·终型
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form
ex.description:
进入[牵缠禁制]后，能量足够时，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
以被[牵缠禁制]的目标为中心，牵引周围敌人并引爆，造成大量火属性伤害，引爆后将退出[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动时，可以闪避敌人的攻击，若成功触发[极限闪避]，将额外累积25%[燎火]；
牵引周围敌人后，点按 【普通攻击键】 ，可以取消引爆，直接衔接第三段[普通攻击]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
After entering Binding Seal and with enough Energy, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Centered on the target affected by Binding Seal, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG. Binding Seal will end after detonation.
Dodge enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a Perfect Dodge is triggered, gain an additional 25% Burning Embers.
After pulling in surrounding enemies, press [Basic Attack] to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the Basic Attack's 3rd hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：月辉丝·弦音
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
使用复数[月辉丝·弦]连续斩击前方范围内敌人并引爆，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动时，伊芙琳将脱掉风衣，并进入[焰舞觉醒]状态，持续整场战斗，[焰舞觉醒]状态下，伊芙琳消耗[燎索点]发动[连携技：月辉丝·绊]时，将会保留1点[燎索点]；
攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，累积1点[燎索点]。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple Lunalux Garrotes and detonates an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG to enemies in the area.
Upon activating this skill, Evelyn removes her jacket and enters the Dance of Awakened Fire state, which lasts for the entire battle. While in the Dance of Awakened Fire state, when Evelyn consumes Burning Tether Points to activate Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare, she will retain 1 point of Burning Tether Point. When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target, entering Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

ultimate.name: 终结技：月辉丝·弦影

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，累积1点[燎索点]。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
While under the Dance of Awakened Fire state, and when Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple Lunalux Garrotes and detonates an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG to enemies in the area.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enters Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：烈锋
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
挥动[月辉丝·弦]斩击周围敌人，造成火属性伤害；
攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Use Lunalux Garrote to slash surrounding enemies, dealing Fire DMG.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

132100001.name: 普通攻击：割弦
132100001.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的攻击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
第五段攻击命中敌人时，伊芙琳会使用[月辉丝·弦]链接主要目标，与其进入[牵缠禁制]。
132100001.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to five attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
When the 5th hit lands against an enemy, Evelyn will use her Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.
